views.front: The machine now has a clear recessed dispensing bay and a connected twin-outlet head above the tray.
views.rear: The original rounded rear case and hopper silhouette remain intact; rear fittings are still simple.
views.detail: Full-size detail shows a real shadowed cup recess, exposed supported grille and separate steam wand; the hopper remains visually opaque under the preserved original material.
views.underside: Both outlet bores are visibly open in the low view, while the case and tray underside remain closed.
views.clay: The cup bay and supporting dispensing head remain readable without materials, clearly improving on pegs attached to a flat box.
